name: icon
summary: The reusable icon element (<obs-icon>) — renders a real product glyph from the shared library (_icons.js, extracted from src/assets/icons/icons.js; ~635 glyphs) by `name`. Accepts kebab (chevron-double-left) or camelCase (chevronDoubleLeft). Reactive: change `name` and the glyph swaps. Inherits the surrounding text color (currentColor) and takes a px/CSS-length `size`. Renders per-icon fill-rule/clip-rule, so glyphs with holes/overlaps (e.g. the theme-auto half-circle) draw correctly. Decorative by default; pass `label` for an accessible name. This is how any icon should be used across the DS — never hand-drawn/inlined SVG.

name.note: icon key from the library (e.g. 'vm', 'docker', 'kubernetes', 'search', 'times', 'filter'). Unknown name → renders nothing.

size.note: px when a number/plain digits; otherwise any CSS length (e.g. '1.2em').

label.note: accessible name → role=img + aria-label. Omit for a decorative icon (aria-hidden).

do: Use <obs-icon name="…"> for every icon — it guarantees a real product glyph and one source of truth.
Let it inherit color (currentColor) from the surrounding text; wrap in a coloured span to recolor.
Give interactive/standalone icons a `label`; leave decorative ones unlabelled (aria-hidden).
Name in kebab (chevron-double-left) OR camelCase (chevronDoubleLeft) — both resolve; find names on the Assets → Icons page.
dont: Hand-draw or inline a one-off <svg> — if a glyph is missing, add it to _icons.js from the product icons.js.
Hardcode a colour on the icon — drive it via the text color so it themes correctly.

a11y.summary: Decorative by default (aria-hidden=true). With `label` it becomes role=img with an aria-label. Size scales with the given length; color inherits so contrast follows the text.

knownIssues: [element] obs-icon renders ICONS[name] from _icons.js (the same set every obs-* component uses). Reactive to `name`/`size`/`label`. Add new glyphs by copying the FULL path from src/assets/icons/icons.js into _icons.js (mind long paths — don't truncate).

Some product glyphs need EVEN-ODD fill (holes/overlapping paths — e.g. the theme-auto half-circle). The icon data carries a per-glyph `fr:"evenodd"` (set in build-icons.mjs) and obs-icon applies fill-rule/clip-rule so they render correctly; a new such glyph must be added to that even-odd set.

selectHint: Any GLYPH (search, chevron, status/action icon)? -> obs-icon name="…". A brand / monitor-type LOGO (Motadata, Citrix, Router, Kubernetes…)? -> obs-logo, NOT obs-icon. A coloured severity dot? -> obs-severity.
decisionFlow: Any monochrome GLYPH (search, chevron, status, action icon)? -> obs-icon name="…" — never a hand-drawn / inline <svg>.
A brand or monitor-type LOGO (Motadata / Citrix / Router / Docker…)? -> obs-logo, NOT obs-icon (obs-icon is monochrome/currentColor).
A coloured severity indicator/dot? -> obs-severity (it carries the colour); obs-icon inherits the text colour.
Icon NAME format? -> kebab (chevron-double-left) OR camelCase (chevronDoubleLeft) both resolve; browse names on the Assets → Icons page.
Glyph missing from the set? -> add it to src/assets/icons/icons.js (build-icons.mjs regenerates _icons.js) — do not inline a one-off SVG.
A glyph with holes/overlaps rendering filled-in? -> it needs even-odd; the icon data carries `fr:"evenodd"` and obs-icon applies fill-rule/clip-rule automatically.
Decorative vs meaningful? -> leave decorative icons unlabelled (aria-hidden); give a standalone / interactive icon a `label` (→ role=img).

lock-glyphs.useWhen: a padlock pair: PRIVATE/locked → lockAlt (closed, with keyhole); PUBLIC/unlocked → lockOpen (open padlock, added in the product 48×48 style; aliases: unlock, lockOpenAlt). `locks` is a closed padlock without a keyhole.
lock-glyphs.dontUse: unlockAlt for "unlock/open lock" — it DRAWS AN UNDO / rotate-left arrow, not a lock (aliased as `undo`/`rotateLeft`). For an open lock use lockOpen.
lock-glyphs.must: pair lockAlt (private) with lockOpen (public); never use unlockAlt to mean unlocked.
lock-glyphs.example: private → <obs-icon name="lockAlt">; public → <obs-icon name="lockOpen">; undo action → <obs-icon name="undo">
